raw_text: FACT CHECK ALERT: An audio clip purportedly of the PM discussing reservations policy changes is going viral on WhatsApp and Telegram. Election Watch India is analyzing the clip for authenticity markers. Initial spectral analysis shows suspicious artifacts in the 8-12kHz range consistent with AI voice synthesis. We urge voters not to share unverified content during the election period. Full forensic report to follow.
